fun_facts: As a kid, Bear Bachmeier staged home-run derbies with a rolled-up sock, had WWE-style ladder matches, and started playing tackle football at age 5.
He would approach strangers with a whiffle ball, take a batting stance, and ask them to throw it to him.
At age 3, he could dribble a basketball between his legs; he also played hallway football.
Before his senior season at Murrieta Valley, he had already thrown for 5,550 yards and 47 touchdowns.
In 2026, he became the first BYU quarterback since Steve Young in the 1983 Holiday Bowl to record a passing, rushing, and receiving touchdown in the same game.
